brief: Build a small single-user notes website. Use React 18, TypeScript 5, Vite 5, FastAPI and local SQLite. Users can create a note with a required title and body, list notes, edit notes and delete notes. Persist notes across server restarts. Use a simple responsive interface. No login, collaboration, AI features, cloud services or external integrations. This is a local student demo for one user; no public deployment or high-scale availability is required.

context.problem_statement: A single-user notes website lacks a persistent, local storage solution for quick note creation and management.
goals: Enable one user to create, list, edit, and delete notes locally with a simple responsive interface.
target_users: A single student using the app locally on their device.
user_journeys: User types title and body, submits to create a note.
User views all notes in a responsive list.
User selects a note to edit title or body.
User removes a note from the list.
